description: Saves an episode’s Ania Script: { titulo, cenas: [{ id, layout, conteudo, falas: [{ id, texto }] }] } (project fields such as apresentadores, marca or formato may be overridden). It is validated with the renderer’s own schema first: on errors NOTHING is saved and the problems come back (in Portuguese) for you to fix and call again; warnings are returned after saving. Layout ids come from studio_listar_layouts and must match the format (v-* only in 9:16). conteudo.tipo: "abertura" {titulo, subtitulo?}, "cartao" {titulo, itens[]} (each item appears when the speech says it), "imagem" {src}, "broll" {src, legenda?, itens[]}, "video" {src}. Files (src, cena.fundo, fala.real[].src) must be the user’s own, sent first with studio_enviar_midia and written as "midia/<name>" (e.g. {"tipo":"imagem","src":"midia/capa.jpg"}); web links are not read here. A web image (midia/web-*, from studio_sugerir_imagens) needs "credito" on its conteudo (imagem/broll) or fala.real entry, or the script is refused. Avatar close-ups (apresentador-lado, talking-head, cam-grande, split-50-50) only to open and close; in between keep the avatar in a corner. Gestures (wave, goodbye, pointing) are added from the speech by the Studio when the script has none. The reply lists text-only scenes: offer the user an image for each (web with free licence, generated, or one of their files), only with their ok. The user’s pronunciation dictionary (studio_pronuncia) applies to every video; lexico {"word":"spoken form"} only for this episode. Lists (steps, benefits) go as an item-by-item card (cartao/broll itens[]), not gestures; a gesto only if the avatar has that action (list_actions), at most 1 per ~45 s. Write calm speech (short sentences), one idea per scene. No presenter (apresentador "nenhum"): every scene uses foco-total (16:9) or v-cheia (9:16). Recorded presenter (apresentador "video", gravacao): each scene with speech gets "gravacao": "midia/cena-N.mp4" — the clip of the user reading exactly that scene’s falas; the reply lists the text to show the user for each recording and which clips are still missing (a missing clip is a warning now, an error at render). Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

revisao.description: Revision you read (studio_ver_episodio); refused if it changed since.

roteiro.description: The episode script (Ania Script v1 without schema/projeto).
